guards: every .gitignore rule declares its category, and a private one names where it durably lives

gates.stated: An ignored path declares WHY it is ignored

poisonPill.why: An emptied accepted-set, so every rule must stand on its own declaration and the undeclared ones must surface. The failure it prevents is silent: a private path is ignored, everyone assumes it lives somewhere durable, nobody checks — which left 37 debt entries on one disk.
